query_records.description: Run a COQL SELECT against your CRM data. Reads the record store directly, so it sees records the moment they are written, which is the reliable way to look one up right after creating it.
query_records.name: query_records

parameters.description: A COQL SELECT statement. Column and module names are Zoho field API names.

examples.label: Contact by email
examples.value: select id, Last_Name, Email from Contacts where Email = 'dana@example.com'

examples.label: Open deals over 10k
examples.value: select id, Deal_Name, Amount, Stage from Deals where Amount > 10000 and Stage != 'Closed Won'

parameters.name: select_query

parameters.description: Row cap, appended as a LIMIT when the query has none (1-2000; Zoho defaults to 200).
parameters.name: limit

returns.description: Response envelope; the records are in the "results" field and the paging block in "info".

items.description: One matching record. Its fields are the ones the query selected, so they vary per query; id is always available.

search_records.description: Find records by email, phone, free text, or a criteria expression. Zoho's search index lags writes by a short while, so a record created seconds ago may not appear yet: use 'Query Zoho CRM records' when you need one immediately.
search_records.name: search_records

parameters.description: Module to search.
parameters.name: module

parameters.description: Which kind of search to run.
parameters.name: search_by

parameters.description: The value to look for. With 'Criteria expression', use Zoho's syntax, e.g. (Last_Name:equals:Smith)and(Email:starts_with:qa).
parameters.name: value

parameters.description: How many records to return (1-200).
parameters.name: limit

returns.description: Response envelope; the records are in the "results" field and the paging block in "info".

items.description: One matching record. Its fields are the ones the query selected, so they vary per query; id is always available.
